notes.title: MAC version of Masters of the World DLCs are now available!
notes.notes:
The two addons, [i][b]2014 Edition[/b][/i]  and the [i][b]Modding Tool[/b][/i] DLCs, are now available for MACOSX

With the [i][b]2014 Edition[/b][/i] add-on, take the plunge into in-depth simulation with this new data set for January 1st, 2014. Plus, thanks to the integrated God'n Spy game mode, you can play the sorcerer's apprentice by changing key values or by creating events at any moment! 

With the [i][b]Modding Tool[/b][/i] add-on, create your own geopolitical scenarios and share them with other players. You will also get access to more than 170 downloadable scenarios created by other players!

Both MAC and PC versions and the DLCs include the recent update 5.32
